verses.verse:
ऋजुधैवत मध्यमयोर्मध्ये स्थाप्यौस्वरौ क्रमात्।
प्रथमो मध्यमस्तीब्रो द्वितीयः पंचमोभवेत।।२०।।
verses.text: Between ṛju Dhaivata and Madhyama two notes are to be placed in order: the first will be tīvra Madhyama, the second Pañcama.

commentary.text: That is, between komal Dhaivata and Madhyama understand the places of two notes at equal distance: the first will be tīvra (sharp) Madhyama and the second the Pañcama note.
